gallery.title: File:Crinkled (11040839506).jpg
gallery.artist: Nicholas A. Tonelli from Northeast Pennsylvania, USA
gallery.description:
American beech (Fagus grandifolia) sapling along the Appalachian Trail west of Fox Gap, Monroe County.

Beeches retain much of their dead foliage through late autumn into winter, adding much-appreciated texture and color to the otherwise barren woods. The leaf colors range from pale yellow-orange to deep orange.

gallery.title: File:Browned (8177486291).jpg
gallery.artist: Nicholas A. Tonelli from Northeast Pennsylvania, USA
gallery.description:
View from the North Trail, Lehigh Gap Nature Center, Carbon and Lehigh Counties. The trail branches off the Appalachian Trail as it ascends the summit of Blue Mountain.

Toxic metals from nearby zinc smelters destroyed the original vegetation here; however, the nature center has been actively revegetating the area. The sparse tree cover provides sweeping views in all directions.
